name: IKHCO | Canal St. Runtz | Live Rosin | 1g
description:
Cross Strains: Pre 64 Runtz x THC Bomb

Experience the sweet, tangy delight of Canal St Runtz, a 1g solventless live rosin crafted for flavor and potency. Carefully pressed to preserve the full spectrum of cannabinoids and terpenes, this live rosin delivers the signature fruity, candy-like notes of Runtz with a smooth, creamy finish. 

Every dab is clean, flavorful, and satisfying, showcasing the art of true solventless craftsmanship.
